summary: Armata Pharmaceuticals filed a Form 8-K on September 23, 2026, reporting receipt of $3.7 million in additional non-dilutive funding from the U.S. Department of War (DoW) to support Phase 3 development of AP-SA02, an intravenous multi-phage candidate for complicated Staphylococcus aureus bacteremia. The award, received through MTEC and managed by NMRC/NAMD, is incremental to prior DoW support, lifting cumulative non-dilutive funding for the program to $32.4 million. No securities, deal terms, board recommendation, or advisors were disclosed; the filing is a routine current report with a press release exhibit and no special-situation transaction.
